title: Germany: who was left out?
hook: Did unification include the other major German power?

predict.question: Was Austria included in the 1871 German Empire?

frames.heading: Denmark
frames.text: Prussia wins a war against Denmark.

frames.heading: Austria
frames.text: War excludes Austria from Prussia’s unification path.

frames.heading: France
frames.text: War against France precedes the empire.

frames.heading: Empire
frames.text: A German Empire forms without Austria.

reveal: Unification did not simply gather every German-speaking territory. Prussia’s victory over Austria in 1866 made Austrian participation increasingly remote, and the empire formed after war against France. The outcome reflected conflicts between states as well as a national movement.
limit: Lines mark wars between states, not troop routes or modern territorial claims.

sources.section: Unification wars 1864, 1866, 1870/71; Reichsgründung 1871 on Austria exclusion
